newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks plunge on reported China war games.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks plunge on reported China war games.

text.p: Taiwan share prices fell sharply minutes before Monday's close following a news report that China would mount war games possibly in protest against a Taiwan visit by Tibet's exiled spiritual leader, the Dalai Lama.
With two minutes left, the index had plunged 3.44 percent or 283.23 points to 7,950.84.
Turnover was an active T$124 billion.
